video_title: What Happened to Sports Journalism? | The Stepback with Blake Griffin

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on Skip Bayless's 'overhyped' criticism in 2012
quotes.excerpt: Too many people to me want another real-life Avenger. Oh look, Blake can fly.
quotes.quote: Too many people to me want another real-life Avenger. Oh look, Blake can fly. First off, that was rude. Second, my entire generation was very specifically told to believe we could fly. Also, kind of mixed messages to say it's a breakout playoff performance and then immediately say that's a bad -- you know what, I'm getting ahead of myself.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton dismisses media criticism during 2025 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I couldn't care less, honestly. Like what do they really know about basketball?
quotes.quote: The commentary is always going to be what it is, you know? Most of the time, the talking heads on the major platforms, I couldn't care less, honestly. Like what do they really know about basketball?

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith responds to Tyrese Haliburton's media criticism
quotes.excerpt: My brother, I'm not going away. I'm going to be here for a while.
quotes.quote: My brother, I'm not going away. I'm going to be here for a while. See the red to news? I'm going to be here for a while. So next year and the year after that and the year after that and the year after that, I'm going to be here. And players far more accomplished and far more superior have made their efforts trying to call me out. How has that worked out? I don't get paid to talk to you. I get paid to talk about you. So whether I speak to them or not or whatever it is, you don't stop this train.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith tells Tyrese Haliburton to focus on winning
quotes.excerpt: Focus on the damn finals. You ain't win it yet. You still got two to go.
quotes.quote: Focus on the damn finals. You ain't win it yet. You still got two to go.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on his contentious relationship with Skip Bayless
quotes.excerpt: Skip had one position, I had the other. We were never on the same page.
quotes.quote: Skip had one position, I had the other. It didn't matter whether we talked to each other before the show, during the show, after the show, it didn't matter. We were never on the same page.

text_blocks.speaker: Mark Cuban
text_blocks.text: It's not just Skip, it's sports writers, sports media in general, where everything's generalities, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Skip Bayless
text_blocks.text: I think LeBron disappeared and shrank in crunch time of the fourth quarter and I can just show you the numbers of what he didn't do in every fourth quarter.

text_blocks.speaker: Mark Cuban
text_blocks.text: So we get no credit for not putting him in a position to succeed, right? We played the Heat. He put himself in it. All he did was stand out on the perimeter.

text_blocks.speaker: Skip Bayless
text_blocks.text: Now, how do you think we defended that? Why do you think he was standing out there?

text_blocks.speaker: Mark Cuban
text_blocks.text: You didn't have to defend it. Oh, right. So no matter what we did, he was just going to stand there and do nothing.

text_blocks.speaker: Skip Bayless
text_blocks.text: Well, I, that's all I saw. That was a lot of it.

text_blocks.speaker: Mark Cuban
text_blocks.text: That's exactly right, Skip. That's all you saw.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: Let's make sure we don't do anything to provoke wrong actions. We got to also make sure that you can do your part to try to make sure it doesn't happen.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith debates SpongeBob SquarePants characters as NFL players
quotes.excerpt: Who do you think is the best athlete in SpongeBob, and if you were to draft a character as your starting QB who would you pick?
quotes.quote: Who do you think is the best athlete in SpongeBob, and if you were to draft a character as your starting QB who would you pick? Ladies and gentlemen, I haven't seen much of SpongeBob. Damn it. But I'm going to entertain y'all by guessing. I'm going to go with Mr. Krabs.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith chooses between Goku and Vegeta
quotes.excerpt: Who are you taking in a 1v1? Goku or Vegeta? From Dragon Ball!
quotes.quote: Who are you taking in a 1v1? Goku or Vegeta? From Dragon Ball! First of all, my condolences. I saw the news alerts that this individual has passed away, Akira Toriyama. Suffered an acute subdural hematoma, a type of bleeding near the brain they say. Obviously hope God blesses his soul and he's up in a higher place. In terms of who I'm taking, Goku or Vegeta from Dragon Ball, I'm going with Goku.
